title: Phoenix Lights footage taken by fake Barwood staffers

tellings.quote: or that night, two men roll up in a unmarked government vehicle and suits and he's like,

plain: A filmmaker named James Fox, on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about the Phoenix Lights, strange lights many people reported over Phoenix, Arizona, in 1997. He passes on an account linked to a woman named Frances Emma Barwood: that night, he says, two men in suits pulled up in an unmarked government car, and the story goes that they posed as her staff and took footage of the lights. If true, it would mean the government quietly collected the evidence.
